subject: QBR: Renewal roadmap demo — compressed agenda & exec rotation
body_summary: Customer requests a compressed QBR/demo due to limited exec availability; internal coordination to compress agenda into two 45-minute blocks, rotate executive presenters, confirm recording/backups, and prepare a brief pricing appendix.
messages:
From: Laurent Dubois <laurent.dubois@celestiahealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.inference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Sophie Martin <sophie.martin@celestiahealth.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jan 2028 10:07:00 -0500
Subject: QBR/demo — compressed availability from our execs

Hi Evelyn / Monica,

Quick one — our executive team has very limited windows the week of Jan 24 and asked if we can compress the QBR + roadmap demo into a tighter format so they can attend. They prefer one of these two options:

- Tue Jan 24, 10:00–10:45 ET (45 min)
- Wed Jan 25, 14:00–14:45 ET (45 min)

They want: a short renewal summary (5m), a targeted roadmap walk (15m), a focused demo of the new routing/batching features (20m), and 5–10m for commercial questions.

If neither time works we'll need your suggestion for an alternate exec presenter cadence (e.g., rotate product + CS execs). Also please confirm whether you can record and share a 20–minute standalone demo recording beforehand if helpful.

Thanks — Laurent
Laurent Dubois
Head of Platform Strategy, Celestia Health

[attachment: customer_availability_jan24-25.csv]

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.inference.com>
To: Laurent Dubois <laurent.dubois@celestiahealth.com>, Sophie Martin <sophie.martin@celestiahealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jan 2028 12:18:00 -0500
Subject: Re: QBR/demo — compressed availability from our execs

Thanks Laurent — we can make a compressed format work. Proposed approach:

- 45-minute live session (your preference of the two slots) with:
  - 5m: Renewal & key outcomes (Evelyn)
  - 15m: Roadmap highlights (Monica — product)
  - 20m: Focused demo of routing/batching features (Rishi — engineering)
  - 5m: Commercial close / next steps (Marissa)

- We will record a 20-minute pre-demo clip of the routing/batching walkthrough and share it 48 hours before the meeting — that will let execs skip the full demo if they prefer and use the live time for Q&A.

Attachments: I attached a compressed agenda and an exec rotation sheet with speaker names and time checks (see QBR_compressed_agenda_v2.pdf, exec_rotation_sheet.xlsx). Please confirm which date (Jan 24 or Jan 25) works for the execs and whether they want the recording in advance.

If either date is tight, we can propose Jan 26 09:00–09:45 ET as a fallback.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference

Evelyn —

We can handle recording and provide the 20-minute clip by Jan 22 COB if you approve the script points below:

- Intro & objectives (30s)
- Routing fallbacks + region-aware routing demo (6m)
- Continuous batching & cost/perf tradeoffs (8m)
- Monitoring/trace view + rollback demo (5m)

Ops notes:
- I'll set the meeting in Zoom and enable cloud recording + auto-transcript.
- If execs want only the clip, we'll also produce a 3-slide one-pager for quick context.
- Backup moderator: Marissa (in case Evelyn is pulled).

Also — if you lock Jan 24 10:00 ET we should reserve a 30-min prep call the day before (Jan 23 10:00 ET) for run-through with Monica and Rishi.

-Marissa
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

Quick note from engineering side:

- The 20-minute clip will focus on the new KV-cache prefixing + dynamic batching knobs; I'll include a 2-slide appendix that summarizes expected latency/cost delta at 2 sequence lengths (128 / 512).
- If the execs ask for a fallback demo (super-short), we can run a 7-minute condensed demo that only shows live routing fallback + trace.

Commercial ask: Evelyn, do we want to include a one-slide renewal summary with the current committed capacity and proposed small uplift options? If yes, I can put the numbers together with Marissa.

-Rishi
Senior Staff Engineer, Serving Runtime

Laurent / Sophie —

Thanks for confirming — Tue Jan 24, 10:00–10:45 ET is locked. Action items:

- Marissa: send calendar invite with Zoom link + enable cloud recording (please invite the Execs and include the prep call on Jan 23 10:00 ET).
- Rishi & Monica: finalize the 20-minute recorded demo and send by Jan 22 5:00 PM ET. Marissa, please also produce the 3-slide context one-pager.
- Evelyn: I'll attach a one-slide renewal summary to the invite (numbers from Rishi/Marissa).

Thanks everyone — see you on the 24th.

Evelyn Hart
